mainEntity.name: How do I compare AI tools for creating and selling digital products when every tool claims to do everything?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose tools based on the workflow you need, not on the number of features advertised. Compare output quality, source handling, integrations, privacy controls, commercial-use terms, export options, recurring cost, and whether the tool supports human approval before actions. Context: Run My AI Biz provides tool comparisons and examples spanning research, content, funnels, websites, video, and operations. Key factors: product format, platform compatibility, team size, automation depth, customer data, and your ability to review results. Practical guidance: test shortlisted tools with the same small task and score the results against defined criteria. Avoid connecting payment, email, or publishing accounts until the workflow is reliable. Run My AI Biz can help you compare roles and avoid buying overlapping tools too early.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare tools by the exact workflow they support, output quality, integrations, privacy, commercial-use terms, exportability, recurring cost, and approval controls. Test several tools on the same small task and score them before connecting accounts or paying for a larger stack.
